messages:
maya: Heads-up — Clearvale flagged items on the vendor security form. They marked SOC2 evidence, subprocessor list, and BYOK/KMS as blockers for go-live. Onboarding ETA is 2 weeks. Who can own each item?
sam: I own contract side — DPA annex for BYOK still pending signature from their legal. I can push today.
vijay: From security: we support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated/Private. Need vendor name for HSM (e.g., AWS KMS vs external HSM), key rotation policy, and whether they require attestation. Also need a clear dataflow diagram showing where plaintext touches Redwood infra.
lina: Eng will produce a minimal dataflow + config snippet for BYOK integration. I can have a draft EOD tomorrow. Also will include an embeddings retention note (we've seen questions there).
maya: Perfect. Can someone add the items to the "hotlist" doc? Confluence link: https://redwood.atl/confluence/clearvale-onboard (placeholder). Proposed 30-min enablement call next Tue 10am PT to walk ops + infra. @sam can you confirm with the customer?
sam: Confirmed — I sent calendar invite to Clearvale and their infra lead.
maya: Also: customer asked for a redacted SOC2 report sample. @legal-bot — can we provide a redacted copy or is NDA required?
legal-bot: We can share a redacted SOC2 report after an executed NDA or MSA clause permitting sharing. Please route formal request to legal@redwood.com with account name + use case.
vijay: Another risk: Clearvale's own SOC2 re-audit is scheduled near their go-live. If their audit slips, they might delay acceptance tests. Recommend we flag renewal/onboarding risk as HIGH and add contingency: fallback to non-BYOK (Redwood-managed keys) for initial rollout.
maya: I'll mark account health with HIGH renewal/onboarding risk and add contingency notes. Lina — can you draft the fallback config snippet we can use if BYOK isn't ready?
lina: Sure — quick config example below (for the enablement deck):
```
# fallback: Redwood-managed key config
storage:
  encryption: managed
  key_id: redwood-default
retention:
  embeddings_days: 30
```
I'll refine for production.
maya: For the vendor form Q4.3 (subprocessors), can someone draft a concise answer we can paste? We want short, plain language and a pointer to our subprocessors page.
vijay: Draft: "Redwood Inference uses a limited set of subprocessors (cloud providers and analytics). A current list is maintained at https://redwood.com/subprocessors. Subprocessor access to customer data is limited and governed by contract and technical controls (encryption at rest, RBAC, audit logs)."
sam: That reads well. I'll add it to the DPA annex and the vendor form response. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks — I'll assemble the enablement slide deck with the dataflow, fallback config, subprocessors blurb, and a short privacy FAQ. Planning to send to Clearvale before the call so they can review.
legal-bot: Reminder: for BYOK specifics (key provenance, rotation windows), legal needs the vendor's attestation and any third-party contracts. Attach those to the legal request.
maya: Noted. I'll collect and send.
---
maya: Quick ask: can we capture any customer feedback after the call re: onboarding friction? I'll add a short Google Form in the follow-up email to get structured feedback (time to provision, clarity of docs, blockers).
sam: Good idea. I linked a short template in the calendar invite notes.
lina: I'll join the call and take notes on technical blockers to feed into eng-oncall if needed.
vijay: I'll prepare a short checklist for security sign-off to accelerate any follow-up reviews.
maya: Great all — owners: sam (contracts/DPA), lina (dataflow + fallback), vijay (security checklist + subprocessors blurb), maya (enablement deck + account health). I'll post updates here after the call. :raised_hands:
